title: 1 Gallon Square Glass Storage Jars with Airtight Lids, 2 Pack Large Glass Pickle Jars for Fermenting, Clear Glass Canister for Flour, Cookie, Candy, Kombucha, Sun tea(Extra Labels and Gasket)
description:
About this item
Perfect Food Storage Set: These glass canning jars measures 5.8"Wx5.8" Wx11.5"H, a 3.3" mouth diameter. 1 gallon capacity, the perfect size to be used as storage jars for pantry and kitchen storage, Ideal for storing pasta, flour, sugar, cereal, coffee, beans, candy, cookies, snacks
Airtight Seal Lid: Each pickle jar comes with a hinged lid and silicone gasket that creates an airtight seal, ensuring contents remain fresher for longer while in storage, preserving aroma, flavor and freshness for your food
Food grade glass: These airtight glass jars with lids made of ultra-thickness glass. Easy to clean, just clean it with a little water, it is dishwasher safe (Lids not recommended in the dishwasher)
See-through Design: The sleek transparent bottle body and squared design make these candy jars look more beautiful and practical, and you can easily view and grab them with just a glance. Of course, you can also enjoy watching the process of food change
Safety Package: All clear glass jars come with a safety package and free accessories: 2 reusable stickers, 1 marker pen and 1 replacement silicone gasket.
Warm tips: Please preheat the bottles with warm water before pouring hot drinks to avoid glass cracking

reviews_5s:
BOUGHT THESE AND I WILL SAY THEY ARE THE BEST GALLON SIZE JARS. I HAD SOME SCREW TOPS, AFTER A YEAR THE LIDS WERE SO HARD TO GET OFF TO POUR MY VANILLA EXTRACT. THESE WERE WAY EASIER AND CAME WITH A MARKER AND SOME LABELS. GOOD JOBThey don't leak! Hold a lot, quite strong, look nice and do the job. What more could I ask?These jars are both beautiful and highly functional! The glass is plenty thick and sturdy, but keep in mind they are glass , so they are breakable. The latch is well made and secures the lid perfectly . I've ordered these twice and plan to order more , but the first time I ordered, they came with an extra gasket , but not the second time. I am willing to overlook this. I don't see the gasket wearing out in my lifetime.
I love these jars because they are square and fit on the shelf without wasting any space . They look pretty enough with contents, that you could display them rather than hiding them away. These would look absolutely wonderful displayed in a country kitchen !
The mouth of these jars is plenty wide enough to put your hand in... while holding items! I guarantee you that I am not just dropping my eggs into the jars for waterglassing storage (not familiar? Look it up.). One jar holds 40 eggs.
Folks who say the mouth is not wide enough for measuring cups need to get different measuring cups.
Ordering was easy and shipping was fast. The jars came packaged very securely with plenty of foam between them, and over and under them. They came packaged with two black labels and a white marker for labeling. This is a wonderful product at a very, extremely fair price. I will be ordering more. Thank you.Nice jars 👍I gave these to my daughter. She absolutely loves them. I will get her more.Great Product! Leak Proof Seal! Used to make pickled eggs!good quality product.Airtight perfect sized containers. I use these for a multitude of gardening and household purposes. They are a perfect size as they can be stored in the fridge or pantry, are ecologically preferable to plastic containers.I use these for storage of things I pour out, or pickle. The tops are too small for scooping things like flour I use the bigger mouthed jars for that. But instead of plastic bags these are great for beans, pasta, egg noodles, rice, or anything you want sealed tight. Thay give you extra seals and a few lables, but since there clear glass I don't use those except when I'm pickling something special! They are glass so handle with care but for me all those plastic storage containers are history, a little at a time I'm replacing them. I especially like the latches like the ones my grandma's jars had when I was a kid, kind of an old fashion look to the kitchen as I keep some on the counter like my spare flour, and sugar!I keep dry goods stored in air-tight containers, and these are perfect. Highly recommend.
